policyRecordedAtStage: post_acquisition_package_validation; selected source membership was already frozen and 142/142 selected payloads had been acquired; this note documents fail-closed behavior and scope exclusions without changing the frozen set

scopeBoundary.included: Exact atomic FJ source IDs routed in the frozen T51 shoulder-scapular and upper-limb chunks, plus FJ3237 and FJ3279 as verified same-source T53 thorax boundary nodes.
scopeBoundary.excluded: Every other source FJ outside the two frozen region memberships is outside T54 scope. It is not counted as a download failure, absent anatomy, or whole-body inventory denominator.

policies.frozenSet: The 142 unique source IDs and 144 memberships are frozen before T54 mesh acquisition. Do not add a discovered source ID to this set during acquisition or build.
policies.missingOrFailedFrozenMember: If a frozen FJ member is absent from the pre-recorded official archive tree, unavailable by range, CRC/hash mismatched, empty, or fails OBJ header/identity validation, retain its exact ID and failure reason and withhold the combined package. Do not silently substitute another tree or infer a replacement ID.
policies.sourceIdentity: Blank or partial OBJ header fields stay null/held. T51 context text does not replace missing source header identity; parent names do not replace a small hand bone or hand muscle.
policies.membership: Repeated region membership points to one HA-MESH-BP3D4-FJ source node. It does not duplicate the source mesh or create canonical learner membership.
policies.handPickingAndLod: Each small hand source mesh retains its own stable source ID and pickingTargetId, independent from lod.lodAssignmentId. The source offers one 99%-reduced level; no alternate source LOD or generated proxy/decimation is available. Filename suffix M is not an LOD signal.
policies.laterality: Preserve source header labels, coordinates, and the T50 frame transform. Record opposite-side surface observations as held; never swap labels, mirror, or reinterpret coordinates to make a pair agree.
policies.rights: Retain the per-file legacy OBJ license header. Local technical QA only; public redistribution remains held until file-level rights reconciliation.
